name: Ancient Sands 6121, 3BDR
headline: Meditative & Blissful 3 BDR Villa @ Ancient Sands | Private Pool
summary: This flattering 3 bedroom villa is located at Gouna's elite community of Ancient Sands. The villa features a private pool and is managed by Xuru Stays.

description.Space:
This waterfront 3 bedroom villa is located in Gouna's beloved Ancient Sands community and features a private pool along with a private rooftop. 

The ground level is made up of two bedrooms facing the pool with their own private bathrooms. While the first level features an open plan fully equipped kitchen, a living room with 2 comfy sofas and large terrace with great views of the surrounding nature. 

It also features a 65 inch smart TV with Airplay and cable channels, washing machine, a Nespresso machine, kettle and a microwave. 

The styling of the villa is tailored to give the guests a relaxing and a meditative vibe.

At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Access: Guests have access to the entire property
description.Interaction:
We are more than happy to answer all of your questions 24/7. Guests can text and call anytime they need help and our team will be there in about 30 mins to solve any issue immediately.

At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.

-Ancient Sands is located 3 KM from Gourmet (grocery store). 
- Abu Tig Marina is a 7 minute drive from Ancient Sands (features many restaurants, cafes and bars)
description.Transit:
Free outdoor parking is available. 
Tuktuks are available to take you anywhere in El Gouna (flat fee).
description.Notes: Please note that smoking is not allowed inside the property. A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.

agreement:
• Kindly note that a damage deposit of USD 200 (or the equivalent in EGP) is required. The payment is collected online as part of the reservation payment and will be reimbursed on the checkout day, provided no damages are incurred.
  • Smoking (including shisha) inside the unit is strictly not allowed. However it is allowed in the unit’s balcony (if applicable). A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.
 • Partying, excessive noise and public alcohol drinking is not allowed. In case of violations, security will be notified and appropriate strict actions will be taken. 
 • Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests stated in the reservation will be granted entry. 
• Egyptian & Arab couples ONLY are required to provide proof of marriage according to Egyptian law. Guests are required to send their IDs or passports to the email (id@xurustays.com) or (id.elgouna@xurustays.com) as per the local regulations.
• El Gouna entry permits require 48 hours to be issued, in case guest IDs and passports are sent less than 48 hours before check in date, entry permits are subject to delay or may not be granted. (In case of disapproval from community security office, guests will be fully refunded).
 • Cancellation more than 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 10% of the total price of the stay.
 • Cancellation between 15 days and 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 50% of the total price of the stay. 
• Cancellation between 7 days and 15 days before the arrival date, we keep 75% of the total price of the stay.
• Less than 7 days, we keep 100% of the price of the stay
• Pets are not allowed, in case of violation, Xuru Stays has the right to cancel the reservation with no refund. 

Thank you for choosing our home for your Holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

Xuru Stays

Positives
- Xura Stays were super responsive and helpful throughout - best Airbnb hosts I have had.
- the place itself is great - the last villa in a line in the Ancient Sands resort so it's private
- pool looks good - was too cold for our trip
- terrace is a lovely feature
- TVs are large and connected to streaming services and international TV
- Wifi is very good
- Furniture is comfortable and good quality

Negatives
- heating is via the AC units and blows out hot dry air that makes it difficult to breathe.  The AC in the main bedroom didn't work and one of our party got sick as it was so cold.
- it's a long trek to the cafe/restaurant if you want to eat there  
- the kitchen isn't equipped for any kind of cooking - there are hardly enough cups for coffee
- bedrooms and bathrooms not as well finished as the lounge

Les photos de la description de ce logement sont complètement retouchés par l’IA. Ne vous attendez pas à cela. Les canapés sont jaunes, les murs en bas sont cassé, de l’enduit tombe partout au sol. Il n’y avait pas de draps housses sur les lits, nous dormions donc sur le matelas qui était tout jaune, tout sales,de même pour les oreillers. La climatisation faisais un bruit immense (50 décibels) pour au final ne pas chauffer et qu’on ai froid tout notre séjour avec notre bébé de 8 mois même en mettant à fond à 30 degrés. Le chauffage de la chambre du haut ne fonctionnait pas du tout. Il y’a qu’une chambre dont le chauffage fonctionnait correctement que nous avons laissé à nos filles. En plus de tout cela le ménage est à revoir, nous avons retrouvé 2 morceaux de verre cassé au sol, où mon bébé marchait à 4 pattes quel tragédie s’il l’aurait trouver avant nous !!! L’hôte est réactif mais ne sert à rien, ne veux rien savoir. A FUIR !!!!!
